parameters.name: Category
parameters.description: The category of the Alibaba Cloud service. For example, ApsaraDB for Redis has `kvstore_standard` (Standard Edition), `kvstore_sharding` (Cluster Edition), and `kvstore_splitrw` (read/write splitting Edition).

parameters.name: EffectiveTime
parameters.description:
The effective period of the alert blacklist policy. The implications of whether this parameter is set are as follows:

- If you do not set this parameter, the alert blacklist policy is permanently effective.

- If you set this parameter, the alert blacklist policy is effective only within the specified time range. The following two format examples are supported:
    - `03:00-04:59`: The alert blacklist policy is effective from 03:00 to 05:00 (exclusive) in local time.
    - `03:00-04:59 UTC+0700`: The alert blacklist policy is effective from 03:00 to 05:00 (exclusive) in UTC+7.

parameters.name: EnableEndTime
parameters.description:
The end timestamp until which the alert blacklist policy takes effect.

Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: EnableStartTime
parameters.description:
The start timestamp from which the alert blacklist policy takes effect.

Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description:
The ID of the alert blacklist policy.

For information about how to obtain the ID of an alert blacklist policy, see [DescribeMetricRuleBlackList](~~457257~~).

parameters.name: Instances
parameters.description: The list of instances of the specified Alibaba Cloud service in the alert blacklist policy.

parameters.name: Metrics
parameters.description:
The monitoring metrics of the instances.

- If you do not set this parameter, the alert blacklist policy applies to all monitoring metrics of the specified Alibaba Cloud service.

- If you set this parameter, the alert blacklist policy applies only to the specified monitoring metrics.

sub_parameters.name: MetricName
sub_parameters.description:
The monitoring metrics name.

Valid values of N: 1 to 10.

sub_parameters.name: Resource
sub_parameters.description:
The extension dimension information of the instance. For example, `{"device":"C:"}` indicates that the alert blacklist policy applies to all C drives of the ECS instance.

Valid values of N: 1 to 10.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the alert blacklist policy.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description:
The namespace of the Alibaba Cloud service.

For information about the namespaces of Alibaba Cloud services, see [Cloud service monitoring metrics](~~163515~~).

parameters.name: ScopeType
parameters.description:
The effective scope of the alert blacklist policy. Valid values:

- USER: The alert blacklist policy takes effect only within the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- GROUP (default): The alert blacklist policy takes effect in the specified application group. You must specify an application group.
  For information about how to obtain the application group ID, see [DescribeMonitorGroups](~~115032~~).

parameters.name: ScopeValue
parameters.description:
The list of application group IDs.

> This parameter is required only when `ScopeType` is set to `GROUP`.
